name: openai-header-router
description: Selects an LLM provider for OpenAI Chat Completions requests based on a configurable request header, then publishes the chosen provider id to shared metadata for downstream translator policies (such as openai-to-anthropic or openai-to-bedrock) to act on. Enables a single OpenAI-shaped endpoint to fan out to multiple providers, chosen per-request by one header.
